qstar_rule: median implied cutoff over informative simulated pairs (min region identity <= 0.80), rounded to 2 decimals
primary_test: held-out real pairs (Section 8.4); the 73 development pairs are reported separately

criteria.P1: For every reference tool R, G with R's q* has a lower mean |error| against R than both Mash and skani.
criteria.P2: For every R other than dnadiff whose q* differs from dnadiff's by >= 0.02, G with R's q* matches R better (lower mean |error|) than G with dnadiff's q*.
criteria.P3: Paired bootstrap (5000 resamples): if the 95% CI of [mean |error| of G_R minus mean |error| of the better of Mash/skani] is entirely below 0, G is 'better'; otherwise 'comparable'.
